about:
Based in Shelburne, Vermont, HomeComing Woodworks operates a custom furniture and restoration workshop serving the greater Burlington area. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom furniture design and fabrication, with a noted emphasis on Craftsman-style pieces, alongside expert antique furniture restoration and refinishing. Its service list includes custom tables, Murphy beds, bathroom vanities, bookcases, cabinet doors, kitchen cabinets, pantries, and shelving, as well as cabinet refinishing and repair. The business also offers 3D rendering to help clients visualize projects. As of the latest Houzz profile, the portfolio displays 68 completed projects spanning furniture restoration, sideboards, chairs, tables, and beds.

HomeComing Woodworks primarily serves residential customers in Chittenden County and surrounding communities, including Burlington, South Burlington, Essex, Colchester, Williston, and Winooski. Its work falls within the home improvement and furniture & accessories sectors, catering to homeowners seeking bespoke furniture, antique restoration, and custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and built-ins.

The company describes its approach as combining "exceptional design and a devotion to craftsmanship," with a particular passion for Craftsman-style furniture. This focus on design quality and traditional craftsmanship is presented as its defining characteristic.
